description: rnews_config.rs:73 — The validation error message is: 'must have either [backend] or [ipfs] with a url'. An operator who has never seen this config before does not know: (a) the exact TOML key name to add, (b) what a minimal [backend] section looks like, (c) which field in [ipfs] is the 'url' (it's api_url but the error says 'url'). Fix: rewrite to say something like: 'config must include either a [backend] section (with type = "...") or an [ipfs] section with a non-empty api_url; see config.example.toml for examples.'
title: Validation error message doesn't say what to add to config
